options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Starting Shard
options.doc:
Determines which Shard will be the one that contains your first checks.
Shards prior to your starting shard will NOT have any checks in them, and the total number of Progressive Shards will be reduced to match the skipped Shards.
You will also be given enough Progressive Speed Upgrades to perform checks in your starting Shard, if enabled.

options.name: Remove Post-Victory Locations
options.doc:
Removes any locations in shards that happen after the goal set in Shard Goal, as well as the Progressive Shard items that would otherwise unlock those Shards.
ex: if Shard Goal is set to 7, this will have 6 Progressive Shards in the item pool and will remove any locations in shards 8, 9, and 10

options.name: Separate Shopsanity Items
options.doc:
For Shopsanity, Archipelago Items will be separate from normal Haste items bought in shops; only purchasing the dedicated AP Shop Item will send a check.
If disabled, a check is sent when any item is purchased and dedicated Archipelago Items will not appear in shops.

Pour la folie des boutiques, les articles d'archipel seront séparés des articles de haste normaux achetés dans les magasins; seul l'achat de l'article dédié AP Shop enverra un chèque.

options.name: Shopsanity Item Chance
options.doc:
Determines the odds of a shop item being an Archipelago Item as a percentage. Each shop slot is calculated independently. 
ex: If this value is set to 30, there will be a 30% chance that a single shop item will be an Archipelago Item, and a combined 65% that there will be at least one AP item in a shop.

options.name: Per-Shard Dynamic Shopsanity Quantity
options.doc:
For Dynamic Per-Shard Shopsanity, determines the percentage used for how many checks are tied to Shop purchases in each Shard, scaled to HALF of the length of said shard (rounded down).
When choosing a percentage, remember that you can change the price of items from the in-game Difficulty menu.
If you do not want to revisit a Shard, keep this value below 100%.
ex: Shards 3 & 8 have a length of 15 & 20 Fragments, respectively. A value of 80% will have 5 Shopsanity checks in Shard 3, and 8 checks in Shard 8.

Each Shard's lengths can be found here: https://github.com/WritingHusky/haste_apworld/blob/main/docs/ShardLengths.md

options.name: Fragmentsanity Distribution
options.doc:
Determines how Fragmentsanity checks are distributed
Linear: Checks are given out every X checks as determined by linear_fragmentsanity_rate
Balanced Triangular: Checks are given out following a halved triangular distribution, capped at 10 fragments between checks
    Check 10: 30 clears -- Check 20: 110 clears -- Check 30: 210 clears -- Check 40: 310 clears -- check 50: 410 clears
Triangular: Checks are given out following a triangular distribution. NOT RECOMMENDED FOR SYNCS.
    Check 10: 55 clears -- Check 20: 210 clears -- Check 30: 465 clears -- Check 40: 820 clears -- check 50: 1275 clears

options.name: Progressive Speed Upgrades
options.doc:
Reduces Zoe's base run speed to 60%, and adds 6 Speed Upgrades into the item pool that increase her base run speed by 10% each (totalling 120% run speed with all 6 upgrades)
Zoe's TOTAL speed includes more than just her BASE run speed; so liberal use of Boost-increasing items, abilities, and good landings will be needed to compensate for this initial reduction
Shards will require a certain number of speed upgrades to logically complete:
    Shards 1-2: No speed upgrades
    Shards 3-4: 1 speed upgrade
    Shards 5-6: 2 speed upgrades
    Shards 7-8: 3 speed upgrades
    Shards 9-10: 4 speed upgrades

options.doc:
Determines whether or not Persistent Items are shuffled into the item pool.
Persistent items will be chosen randomly from their corresponding category at the start of a Shard and .
It is recommended that you enable "Unlock All Items" to increase the variety of items seen during a run.

options.name: Persistent Item Quantities
options.doc:
Determines how many of each Persistent Item are added into the item pool.
Items are broken up based on Rarity and Category, with the exception of Legendary Items which are their own group.
Some items have multiple effects and will thus be present in multiple categories.

Items are categoriezed as such:
- Speed: Any item that grants Boost, Speed, spawns a Boost Ring, or grants a special movement option
- Support: Any item grants Energy, Sparks, Luck, Cooldown reduction, Item retriggers, or Perfect landings
- Health: Any item that grants Healing, increases Max Health, or grants Invulnerability

Valid Keys:
- "common_speed"
- "common_support"
- "common_health"
- "rare_speed"
- "rare_support"
- "rare_health"
- "epic_speed"
- "epic_support"
- "epic_health"
- "legendary"

Valid Values:
- a number from 0 to 10 for the key type
- "random", which will pick a random valid value for you
- a range in the form "x-y", which will pick a random valid value between x and y

options.name: Hub NPCs
options.doc:
Shuffles Daro, Niada, Wraith, The Captain, and Fashion Weeboh into the item pool; requiring you to find them before they can be talked to in the hub world.
This will not affect the ability to find them in the rest/campfire fragments, as those encounters only provide flavour text

options.name: Captain's Upgrades
options.doc:
Shuffles The Captain's permanent upgrades into the item pool, and adds their respective purchases from him in the hub as checks.
All purchases will require 33,250 Anti-Sparks total.

Logically, later purchases in each upgrade line will expect (but not require) additional Progressive Shards:
    Purchase 1-2: No additional Shards
    Purchase 3-4: 2 additional Shards
    Purchase 5: 4 additional Shards
    Purchase 6: 6 additional Shards
    EXCEPTION: The first and only 'Max Lives' Upgrade purchase expects 2 additional Shards, as it is the same price as Purchase 4 in other upgrade lines

options.name: Fashion Weeboh Purchases
options.doc:
Shuffles Fashion Weeboh's costume purchases as checks. Currently does NOT add the costumes themselves as items into the item pool.
Any costumes unlocked after your Shard Goal (unless Remove-Post-Victory-Locations is disabled) will NOT be included in Vanilla or Vanilla Plus.
All purchases will require 22,500 Anti-Sparks total for Vanilla, or 22,700 for Vanilla Plus or All Unlocks.

Logically, costumes that cost 3,000 Anti-Sparks will expect (but not require) 2 additional Progressive Shards to purchase, and costumes that cost 5,000 will expect 4 additional Progressive Shards

Vanilla: Costume purchases are only available as per their vanilla requirements:
    Little Sister (100) and Supersonic Zoe (100): Unlocked by default and do not need to be purchased
    Zoe the Shadow (500) and Zoe 64 (5,000): Available as soon as the Fashion Weeboh is available
    Weeboh (3,000): Unlocks after unlocking Shard 5
    Flopsy (3,000): Unlocks after unlocking Shard 7
    Crispy (1,000): Unlocks after unlocking Disaster Shard 1
    Twisted Flopsy (5,000): Unlocks after unlocking Disaster Shard 2
    Totally Accurate Zoe (5,000): Unlocks after obtaining all Abilities
Vanilla Plus: The same conditions as above, plus Little Sister and Supersonic Zoe's purchases are available as soon as the Fashion Weeboh is available.
All Unlocks: All costume purchases are available as soon as the Fashion Weeboh is available

options.doc:
Determines the percentage of ALL FILLER that will be converted into Disaster Traps.
Disaster Traps will add the Disaster Shard Level 1 effects (lava flowers & health loss on low speed) to the current fragment.
The trap will persist until either the fragment is cleared or Zoe dies, whichever happens first.
